## Weekly Operational Status
Pulls workstreams, risks/decisions and leadership calendar checkpoints, computes the roll-up in code, drafts an executive summary with Claude, and emails a formatted report **to the reviewer first**.

Start with the **Config** node. Full setup: docs/setup.md

**Numbers are computed in code, not by the model.** The AI step only writes the headline and the attention/watch lists from the computed facts. If it fails or is disabled, the report still sends with a rule-based summary.
